fixtures.name: gap-needs-snapshot
fixtures.title: a missing lseq stops applying and asks for GET /live

fixtures.name: gap-recovers-from-snapshot
fixtures.title: after GET /live the stream continues above the snapshot lseq; a new epoch asks for a snapshot again

fixtures.name: killed-without-stop
fixtures.title: a turn whose provider process is killed without a stop (exit 137) ends failed: the running tool is interrupted, the turn has ended_at_ms and worked_ms, and the status line reads interrupted

fixtures.name: new-prompt-over-unsettled-turn
fixtures.title: a new prompt preempts a turn that never settled: the old turn ends interrupted (its running tool too) before the new turn opens, the new turn starts empty, and nothing from the old turn lands in it

fixtures.name: new-turn-replaces-items
fixtures.title: a turn op with a new turn_id drops the last turn's items (their rows are in /log); the same turn_id again keeps them

fixtures.name: stopped-mid-tool
fixtures.title: a turn stopped while a tool runs: the tool is interrupted, the turn ends interrupted with worked_ms, and an explicit interrupted status op follows

fixtures.name: turn-full
fixtures.title: one Claude turn: thinking, commentary, an explore group, a long failing command, an edit with a diff, then an interrupt
